display_contract.index_formula: index_t = arithmetic mean of available oriented_index_t component values
display_contract.interpretation_rule: Derived indices are transparent comparative analytical products, not causal or predictive verdicts.
display_contract.mixed_frequency_rule: Derived composites may carry each component most recent real observation internally; source observation dates remain traceable and no synthetic source observation is written.
display_contract.nonpositive_baseline_rule: A zero or negative baseline is not ratio-rebased. No substitute transformation is invented inside the derived-index pipeline.
display_contract.ratio_eligibility_rule: Ratio rebasing is structurally invalid for a canonical series whose observed history spans zero or contains zero. Such a component is omitted consistently from ratio-derived composites and the omission is exposed; it is never conditionally included merely because one selected horizon happens to start positive.
display_contract.v1: Risk, Growth and Macro are displayed together in the single NOW chart footprint from a common baseline of 100.
display_contract.v2: Selecting Risk, Growth or Macro replaces V1 in the same NOW chart footprint. The selected index reference plus every governed component are displayed together from a common baseline of 100. Selecting a component opens its contextual information card while remaining in V2; only More info opens V3.

components.role: Federal Reserve manufacturing output; owner-approved open replacement for explicitly excluded ISM PMI

growth.construction_detail: Growth explicitly excludes ISM Manufacturing PMI because no permissible free source exists. Federal Reserve IPMAN manufacturing production is the owner-approved open replacement and is not PMI.

excluded_components.distinction: IPMAN is a real-output index, not a PMI diffusion index.
excluded_components.name: ISM Manufacturing PMI
excluded_components.reason: No permissible free historical/current source; owner approved replacement.

growth.name: Growth

purpose: Accepted Market Navigator Risk/Growth/Macro definitions. Equal-weight, direction-adjusted, rebased 100 where ratio rebasing is mathematically meaningful.
